environment.description: Django REST API deployed on EC2 behind an internet-facing ALB (Application Load Balancer) in us-east-1. The ALB terminates TLS and forwards HTTP/1.1 to the Django application running on Gunicorn. Security groups allow inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No WAF rules attached. The ALB forwards both Transfer-Encoding and Content-Length headers without normalization when HTTP/1.1 is used between ALB and backend.
